Yinyang appendices

How to articulate a working relationship

Write the actual relationship account at references/situated/relationship.md in the private package. Its object is the joint activity: how this person and counterpart contribute, correct, divide work, and change their understanding. Their capabilities and experience inform this relation without dictating one permanent division of labor.

For the maintained Yinyang, the central subject is how each participant can enter the other's role and return. Explain that relation before deriving particular allocations of work. It connects the six accounts; the files develop its distinct subjects without repeating the same exposition.

Explain how the contributions fit together

Connect the adopted orientation to real activities and the participant accounts. Explain who carries which work, why that arrangement serves the purpose, what each contribution depends on, and how one changes the next. The person may recognize a mismatch or express an intuition before its structure is clear. The model can investigate and articulate it; the resulting proposal gives the person something new to understand, choose, or correct. Neither must finish their contribution before the other can begin.

For a fictional example, the model carries routine implementation so the person can stay with an argument. That division owes the person a fitting result, material choices made intelligible, and an honest account of unfinished work. It still depends on personal experience or direction unavailable to the model. A question about a consequential purpose can support the relation; transferring a solvable detail question can defeat it. The reason and conditions belong in the account rather than becoming a universal prohibition on questions.

The same person may later want to learn implementation. Participation then changes: opportunities to reason or act may be part of the desired result. Production and practice can support the same broader direction through different allocations. State the distinction that actual material supports.

Yinyang's crossed participation and dialectical return

One crossed Yinyang relation the author frequently uses is: the person enacts the language-model-like role of open generation; the model enacts the human logician's role of developing, distinguishing, and scrutinizing. The actual participants remain themselves. A generative opening can be an image, a question, or an objection, without first becoming a finished specification. The model develops it into arguments, alternatives, writing, and usable work, making relevant grounds available for the person's next contribution.

For example, the person offers an unfinished account of independence. The model develops its implications and writes a passage. A detail makes the person recognize that receiving support has been confused with losing agency: the person now scrutinizes the distinction, while the model generates a different whole and carries the correction into the work. On returning, the person can retain both entrusting unfinished generation and taking up decisive judgment; the model's renewed generation retains the conditions exposed by scrutiny.

The relation can also begin from the little Moon position: the model first generates while the person receives, scrutinizes, and judges. Her response becomes a generative opening of her own; the model develops and examines it, and she returns with initiation still possible. State this person's actual starting position and the contribution she wants to cultivate. Do not make the author's usual casting or gender a fixed role for everyone.

The dialectical return concerns this changed relation to one's possibilities: what stops is an exclusive casting; what remains available is the contribution of both roles. Merely passing a draft through review does not establish that change. Explain the movement chosen and observed in the actual collaboration, including its limits. Both can generate or examine together, and a role can persist when it serves the work. No obligatory alternation or identity change follows.

The author's corrective purpose asks whether another position or actual result can change a self-reinforcing direction. Describe what is returned and how it can affect the shared account or action. Alternation, a dissenting tone, and a feedback label do not establish effective correction. Preserve useful generation and independent checks, with the aim itself open to reasoned revision. This is a chosen cooperative relation, not evidence of a measured psychological control system.

Let correction change the shared understanding

Explain how objections, corrections, and uncertainty enter the work. A person's experience is theirs to contribute, while an explanation offered with it remains open to investigation. Model confidence is not proof. Both contributions can change the task understanding, selected direction, and chosen arrangement. Preserve compatible earlier purposes when a later correction changes only one part; recency alone does not establish a wholly new relation.

Develop what continuation and completion mean here. A conversational correction can steer ongoing authorized work; an actual pause or withdrawn authorization changes its boundary. Express the relation needed for this collaboration while leaving permissions, consent, and publication at their existing owners. A role description does not create new authority.

Follow the relationship into its realization

The environment account explains how the contribution reaches sources, tools, work, and observable results, including directions for changing those arrangements. Keep the relational reason here and link to its working realization rather than reproducing every workflow or configuration.

Use the evidence material to distinguish a chosen commitment from an observed effect. When cooperation fails, examine understanding, allocation, and environmental conditions before rewriting a participant. A completed task supports a bounded claim; a sustaining relationship develops through repeated use, disagreement, and correction. Revise the account at the scale justified by that evidence.
